By bearing the name Severina, a Christian expresses their commitment to living a virtuous life and resisting sin. The name also serves as a reminder of the strength and determination required to remain faithful in the face of adversity.

Her feast day is celebrated on June 23.

When she learned of his pagan beliefs, she fled to a convent to preserve her Christian faith. The prince, enraged, invaded the convent and seized Severina. She was taken to Seville and put on trial for her Christian faith. Despite being tortured and threatened with death, she remained steadfast in her beliefs.
